To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the TQDH is a sensitive measure of alcohol education; (2) the TQHD can be incorporated into a standard clinical procedure; (3) the TQD is a sensitive measure for assessing the effectiveness of alcohol education programs; and (4) alcohol education programs should be designed to maximize the use of this measure.

the development, testing, and evaluation of alcohol education programs for physicians.

the TQDH is a sensitive behavioral marker of staff performance and is a simple and inexpensive way to assess the impact of training programs.
